name: Marina Abramović: Balkan Erotic Epic
description: A bold new performance work marking the 75th anniversary of the Berliner Festspiele. This durational ritual explores ancient Balkan myths through performance art, examining the eroticism, spirituality and traditions of Abramović's homeland with a cast of more than 30 performers, dancers, musicians and singers. The exhibition features film work and live performances that merge mythology with contemporary performance.
